propositions: A one-time backfill script must retroactively create caused_by links on existing closed bugs by reusing the conservative single-culprit resolver from the live auto-derivation pipeline.
The backfill script must be idempotent by checking _is_active_link before writing each link and skipping bugs that already carry an active caused_by edge to the resolved culprit.
The backfill script must default to --dry-run mode for safety, allowing previews before actual writes; back-out is achieved by removing the additive links.
The backfill script must propose exactly one caused_by link for single-culprit bugs and skip ambiguous bugs with multiple candidate culprits.
Re-running the backfill script in write mode must produce zero new links when caused_by edges already exist, proving idempotency.
